column1: # Piecewise vertical projection model of the map.
# The map is a world map + a separate Antarctica map merged vertically
# squashed to the engine's pixel budget -> different vertical scales per band
# ("two aspect ratios"). Each band maps a normalized row range to a latitude
# range; longitude is equirectangular across the full width.
# Values below were detected automatically (land-fraction correlation vs
# Natural Earth: world band corr 0.94
# the exact figures from your source maps if you have them.
# Both poles reach the actual pole points (+90 at the very top row
# very bottom row) -- confirmed by the map author. The seam (~-60/-65) is where
# the world map and the Antarctica map were joined.
# Projection per band (proj column): equirect | mercator.
#   - The Antarctica band is equirectangular (author-confirmed).
#   - The WORLD band was authored in Mercator
#     vertically to fit the pixel budget
#     high-latitude stretch. Measured land/sea fit against Natural Earth:
#         equirect 12.72%  vs  pure mercator 13.23%  disagreement.
#     So equirect aligns slightly BETTER and is the default here. Switch the
#     world band's proj to "mercator" below if you prefer the source geometry.
# columns: name
